claims.originating_goal: Provide a bounded generic login page that visibly proves manual LOGIN/SUCCESS/FAILED state and exposes an automated path through the identical submit handler without publishing the accepted plaintext fixture.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after the credential-hiding page, account-option links and exact automated same-handler validator pass hosted validation, merge, and public publication is observed; otherwise remain fail-closed with this claim.
expected_evidence: manual page visibly renders LOGIN before submission
accepted out-of-band fixture yields SUCCESS through the normal form submit handler
wrong credentials yield FAILED through the normal form submit handler
Forgot password and Create account links appear before Submit and carry no account authority
published page contains no visible plaintext credential fixture or query-string auto-fill shortcut
automation supplies candidates externally and invokes the same form submit handler
no credential persistence or real authentication authority
collision_boundaries: test-only surface; no production identity/session authority
no SKAP credential authority or credential custody
no real secret values in repository state
do not modify existing login/authentication surfaces
no provider credential or GitHub-token runtime authority
claims.next_task_after_release: Use the published page for physical manual SUCCESS observation and an externally supplied automated same-handler SUCCESS/FAILED path validation.
